subtasks: Place all the objects into the box with their front sides facing left.
Place the held hammer lengthwise inside the box with the hammer head on the left and handle on the right, leaving room for the shoe, car and toothbrush.
Straighten the upright box so its long edges run from left to right across the table. Keep the hammer inside.
Place the toy car lengthwise in the open space inside the box with the front of the car pointing left. Keep the hammer inside and leave room for the shoe and toothbrush.
Pack the shoe lengthwise into the box with its toe pointing left and heel pointing right. Use the free space beside the car and hammer, leaving room for the toothbrush.
Place the toothbrush lengthwise in the box, with its brush head pointing left and handle pointing right. Use a free narrow space beside the car, shoe and hammer.
Return both arms to their initial poses with both grippers fully open, leaving all four packed objects undisturbed.
